question: Can a fixed small neural regressor rank the 3010-partition prime m=2 radix census below the certified degree-42 baseline while respecting censored Hilbert lower bounds?

claims.text: Evaluate five-fold held-out exact-degree MAE of one fixed 6-4-1 MLP against a censored-aware constant baseline on the 35 exact rows; keep 2975 certified lower bounds as one-sided constraints.
Train once on all 3010 cases and check every predicted sub-42 flag against its exact degree or certified lower bound; any contradiction is rejected as a lead.
No claim about new factor-base point sets, other m, curves, families, FFD, LFD, solving degree, or runtime improvement.

hypotheses.statement: The fixed MLP yields descriptively lower held-out exact MAE than the fold-specific censored-aware constant on the 35 exact records.

predictions.minimum_effect: Any decrease, reported descriptively without an inferential claim.

arms.description: Training-fold intercept-only estimator optimized under the same equally weighted exact and lower-bound hinge objective

parameters.objective: equal-weight exact MSE and one-sided lower-bound squared hinge

arms.description: One fixed six-feature, four-tanh-hidden-unit, linear-output neural regressor

aa.not_applicable_reason: Deterministic model fit; no timing or stochastic algorithm comparison.

positive.not_applicable_reason: No held-out positive-lead control exists; the all-binary degree 42 is a reference, not a training/evaluation positive.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Certificate joins are outcome verification, not a null-population control; every flag is still checked against an exact value or lower bound.

factors.name: input_dataset
factors.how: All 3010 partitions from the same prime m=2, n=83, fixed 2^27 candidate domain and fixed point base; manifest SHA-256 bound in analysis plan.

factors.name: features
factors.how: Six label-free partition summaries; no labels, censor status, Hilbert coefficients, or witnesses.

factors.name: split
factors.how: SHA-256 of domain tag plus serialized parts modulo five; exact labels only are held out, all censored rows remain in training.

factors.name: loss
factors.how: Equal average of exact squared error and one-sided squared lower-bound violation; no lower-bound imputation.

factors.name: optimization
factors.how: 6-4-1 tanh/linear MLP, Adam 160 epochs, learning rate .01; no tuning.

factors.name: host
factors.how: One CPU Spot Kubernetes Job, one thread; runtime is not a metric.

factors.name: model_architecture
factors.how: One fixed intercept-only censored-aware baseline versus the specified MLP; architecture and all hyperparameters remain fixed.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Deterministic fixed split and computation; no randomized arm order.

seed_derivation.note: Fixed per-fold MLP initialization seeds; full-data seed 20261030; no seed search.

instance_sampling.rule: Exhaust all 3010 manifest-bound partition records. Exact-row fold is SHA-256 over tag n83-radix-neural-fold-v1 concatenated with serialized parts, interpreted from first eight digest bytes big-endian modulo 5.

blinding.how: Exploratory deterministic computation with exact rows visible to frozen fold assignment only through labels for training/test scoring.

power.note: Finite census; only 35 exact labels and 2975 deterministic lower-bound observations. Descriptive within-census CV only; no inferential p-value.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Resource cap only; not a performance estimate.

primary.name: held-out exact degree MAE
primary.definition: Mean absolute error over the 35 exact rows, each scored only in its SHA-assigned held-out fold.

primary.name: held-out constant degree MAE
primary.definition: Same held-out rows and folds using fold-specific censored-aware constant baseline.

secondary.name: full-fit predictions below 42
secondary.definition: Count of censored rows with full-fit prediction below 42.

secondary.name: flags refuted by certificates
secondary.definition: Flagged censored rows whose certified lower bound is at least 43.

stopping_rules.rule: One deterministic five-fold CV plus one all-data fit; score all 3010 rows and join all flags to certificates.
Two CPU, 2GiB memory, 900-second deadline, one attempt; preserve any failure and output receipt.

invalidation_rules: Input manifest mismatch invalidates the run.
Any missing or duplicate case invalidates the run.
Any protocol or binary hash mismatch invalidates the run.
A certified contradiction disqualifies the flagged row as a lead.

decision_rule.text: Report only the fixed-census descriptive MAEs and certificate-checked flag counts. Any below-42 flag contradicted by a certified degree/bound is rejected. A flag without a certificate is unresolved, never a lead claim.
decision_rule.statistic: Descriptive held-out exact MAE and deterministic certificate join
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: difference in held-out exact MAE; descriptive only

inputs: 3010 case JSON files in raw census manifest, all individually SHA-256 and byte-length verified against that manifest
Separate custody checksum-list file manifest.sha256 SHA-256 6dfb197cd95ee385c72f8874c3acddd9661ab2000515503449c1d261f8019dad (not the manifest.json digest)
fixed point-base identity and n83 prime m=2 metadata

graphs: Five-fold held-out exact prediction scatter and baseline comparison; per-row certificate-checked flags.

inadmissible: Replacing a certified lower bound with an exact label or point imputation
Calling a model flag a factor-base point set or a new lead before exact verification
Generalizing this one-base, one-family, one-m encoding census to other m, curves, or factor-base sets
Reporting FFD, LFD, solving degree, runtime, attack or security improvements
Tuning model, folds, seeds, or threshold after seeing evaluation results
Dropping failed, partial, or certificate-contradicted outputs

literature.claim: Right-censoring needs an explicit observation model; this study uses only a deterministic one-sided algebraic hinge, not Tobit likelihood.
literature.verified_by: Abstract and paper reviewed during protocol design.

amendments.reason: The prior draft bound the repository custody checksum-list digest as if it were the raw census manifest.json digest. Downloaded raw manifest bytes hash to 5546a85f4a7e4467289bc3d167845f9054dbbfb546d75949f0a9fceec6e70e78; all 3010 case paths, byte lengths and SHA-256 values in that manifest were verified before model fitting.
changes: Preserve protocol v1 unchanged as superseded and freeze this v2 protocol for the run.
Bind raw manifest.json by its actual SHA-256 and separately identify the custody checksum-list digest.
Retain the same dataset, model, folds, features, loss, baseline, metrics and decision rules.
